verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
Woe unto those who give short measure;

verses.ar: الَّذِیۡنَ اِذَا اکۡتَالُوۡا عَلَی النَّاسِ یَسۡتَوۡفُوۡنَ ۫﴿ۖ۳﴾
verses.en: Those who, when they take by measure from other people, take it full;
But when they give by measure to others or weigh to them, they give them less.
w: they give by measure to others

verses.en: Do not such people know that they will be raised again
Unto a terrible day,
The day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

verses.ar: کَلَّاۤ اِنَّ کِتٰبَ الۡفُجَّارِ لَفِیۡ سِجِّیۡنٍ ؕ﴿۸﴾
verses.en: Nay! the record of the wicked is in Sijjin.
And what should make thee know what Sijjin is?
It is a Book written comprehensively.
Woe, on that day, unto those who reject,
Who deny the Day of Judgment.

verses.ar: وَمَا یُکَذِّبُ بِہٖۤ اِلَّا کُلُّ مُعۡتَدٍ اَثِیۡمٍ ﴿ۙ۱۳﴾
verses.en: And none denies it save every sinful transgressor,

verses.ar: اِذَا تُتۡلٰی عَلَیۡہِ اٰیٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِیۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۱۴﴾
verses.en: Who, when Our Signs are recited unto him, says: ‘Fables of the ancients!’

verses.ar: کَلَّا بَلۡ ٜ رَانَ عَلٰی قُلُوۡبِہِمۡ مَّا کَانُوۡا یَکۡسِبُوۡنَ ﴿۱۵﴾
verses.en: Nay, but that which they have earned has rusted their hearts.

verses.ar: کَلَّاۤ اِنَّہُمۡ عَنۡ رَّبِّہِمۡ یَوۡمَئِذٍ لَّمَحۡجُوۡبُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۱۶﴾
verses.en: Nay, they will surely be debarred from seeing their Lord on that day.
Then, verily, they will burn in Hell,

verses.ar: ثُمَّ یُقَالُ ہٰذَا الَّذِیۡ کُنۡتُمۡ بِہٖ تُکَذِّبُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۱۸﴾
verses.en: Then it will be said to them, ‘This is what you used to reject.’

verses.ar: کَلَّاۤ اِنَّ کِتٰبَ الۡاَبۡرَارِ لَفِیۡ عِلِّیِّیۡنَ ﴿ؕ۱۹﴾
verses.en: Nay! but the record of the virtuous is surely in ‘Illiyyin.
And what should make thee know what ‘Illiyyun is?
It is a Book written comprehensively.
The chosen ones of God will witness it.
Surely the virtuous will be in bliss,
Seated on couches, gazing.
Thou wilt find in their faces the freshness of bliss.
They will be given to drink of a pure sealed beverage,
w: they will be given to drink

verses.ar: خِتٰمُہٗ مِسۡکٌ ؕ وَفِیۡ ذٰلِکَ فَلۡیَتَنَافَسِ الۡمُتَنَافِسُوۡنَ ﴿ؕ۲۷﴾
verses.en: The sealing of it will be with musk — for this let the aspirants aspire —
w: the sealing of it will be

verses.en: And it will be tempered with the water of Tasnim,
A spring of which the chosen ones will drink.

verses.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِیۡنَ اَجۡرَمُوۡا کَانُوۡا مِنَ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا یَضۡحَکُوۡنَ ﴿۫ۖ۳۰﴾
verses.en: Those who were guilty used to laugh at those who believed;
And when they passed by them, they winked at one another.

verses.ar: وَاِذَا انۡقَلَبُوۡۤا اِلٰۤی اَہۡلِہِمُ انۡقَلَبُوۡا فَکِہِیۡنَ ﴿۫ۖ۳۲﴾
verses.en: And when they returned to their families they returned exulting;

verses.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَوۡہُمۡ قَالُوۡۤا اِنَّ ہٰۤؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۳﴾
verses.en: And when they saw them they said, ‘These indeed are the lost ones!’
But they were not sent as keepers over them.

verses.ar: فَالۡیَوۡمَ الَّذِیۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا مِنَ الۡکُفَّارِ یَضۡحَکُوۡنَ ﴿ۙ۳۵﴾
verses.en: This day, therefore, it is the believers who will laugh at the disbelievers,
Seated on couches, gazing.

verses.ar: ہَلۡ ثُوِّبَ الۡکُفَّارُ مَا کَانُوۡا یَفۡعَلُوۡنَ ﴿٪۳۷﴾
verses.en: Are not the disbelievers duly paid for what they did?
